messages:
lina: Following up on model pinning tradeoffs  proposal: instead of a monolithic manifest or tiny token, what about a compact chained-delta format? idea: keep a small chain-head pointer in the hot KV index and store deltas (content-addressed) in object store. That lets us incremental-update pins without rewriting huge manifests.

omar: interesting. chain head stored in index = single 32b content-hash. resolver fetches chain head -> either expand by loading cached manifest or replays a few deltas. This reduces hot IO if most rolls are small.

devin: runtime constraints: we need sub-ms path for lookups. replaying deltas on serve could add latency. we should require that the chain depth served-from-cache <= 1 for hot paths. otherwise resolvers fallback to cached expanded manifest.

lina: agreed. invariant: hot KV value = {"chain":"ca:...","cache_hint":"manifest://..."} (pseudo). normally resolvers just use cached expanded manifest in memory; only on cache-miss they fetch the chain and rebuild.

sam: rollout semantics question: how do we model canaries and traffic splits? single chain head represents a logical state; splits are routing-table entries external to the pin. we can include a small routing-tag in the chain head metadata so resolvers can map to routing service. keep routing policies separate from pinned artifact content.

omar: separation keeps token tiny but forces a second lookup to routing table. acceptable if routing table is tiny (in-memory) and keyed by rollout_tag. that also lets us change split percentages without touching pins. win.

ops-maya: storage/migration perspective: many tenants rely on full-manifest semantics today. migrating to chain requires dual-write: write both expanded manifest and chain-head pointer. index schema additive: value becomes JSON with top-level fields: "manifest_url", "chain_head", "manifest_hash". legacy resolvers continue to read manifest_url. new resolvers prefer chain_head + cached manifest.

devin: safety rollback: if a model must be pulled fast, we need ability to push a deny-entry that short-circuits chain head. propose a small ephemeral denylist (push) + ability to publish a new chain-head marked retired. resolvers subscribe to retire events for hot items.

lina: provenance: each delta carries metadata: author, ts, change_type (pin/evict/rollout_tag_update), and prev_hash. full audit is available by replaying chain. we should also store a compact merkle root for quick manifest integrity checks.

sam: observability: instrument metrics: pin.cache_hit_ratio, chain.replay_latency_p50/p99, chain-depth-distribution, routing_tag_miss_rate. also log expanded-manifest fetch with short id for Console debug.

omar: encoding: deltas should be small serde records (msgpack) and stored under s3://pins/deltas/<sha256>. delta id is content-hash. chain_head is pointer to latest delta or full manifest (if snapshot). periodic snapshotting to collapse chains longer than N deltas.

ops-maya: ops playbook: step 1 dual-write for 2 weeks; step 2 enable resolver chain-read in canary region; step 3 monitor chain.replay_latency and cache_hit_ratio; step 4 snapshot long chains weekly; step 5 flip default to chain-first. include client compatibility notes for on-prem/control-plane variants.

devin: client-side SDK impact: SDKs that introspect manifest must keep using expanded manifest URL. runtime-only paths use chain head. also we should provide a debug endpoint that expands chain head quickly for humans.

lina: small prototype: I'll open a draft PR that implements chain-head read + cache-lookup and a sigh-and-store delta writer. prototype will include a tiny CLI to create deltas and publish chain-heads (ETA 6d).

sam: security: how do we ensure deltas weren't tampered with? content-addressing helps, but we should sign chain heads with control-plane key and include signature in index value. resolvers verify signature before trusting chain.

ops-maya: key rotation note: use existing KMS wrapping, resolvers cache public keys for 30s, fall back to manifest fetch on key mismatch. document edge-case when key rotates during large rollout.

ci-bot: snapshot created: control-plane/experiments/delta-pins/5890012345

lina: thanks all. we'll review the PR in the design sync on Thursday. any objections to the plan?

omar: no objections from me. small nit: define max_chain_replay = 2 for hot path.

devin: +1, add stress tests for chain replay under p99 load.

ops-maya: +1, will draft migration playbook after PR merges.

lina: great, closing for now.
